result.summary: The interface presents a functional layout, though it contains minor visual inconsistencies and redundant content elements.

issues.description: The text 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel.
issues.suggestion: Adjust text container constraints or utilize a dynamic font size to ensure full visibility.

issues.description: Redundant delivery fee information is present on the Ramen Bar card, showing '€0 delivery' in both a badge and text string.
issues.suggestion: Consolidate the delivery information to a single location to reduce visual clutter.

issues.description: The interface relies on generic vector illustrations instead of high-quality product photography, making it appear unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder-style graphics with actual food photography to improve visual appeal and trust.
